gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed progressive medulloblastoma, malignant glioma or any other recurrent/progressive malignant brain tumor, for which curative measures do not exist.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] WP1066: There will be 5 groups based on the enrollment timing.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: WP1066 in Children With Refractory and Progressive or Recurrent Malignant Brain Tumors

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Individual plasma concentration-time data for WP1066 will be used to generate pharmacokinetic parameter estimates using both compartmental and non-compartmental methods.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The level of activated Stat3 (phospho-Stat3) will be measured in the peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), the type of immune cells present in the blood, and the immune cytokines in the serum of subjects pre and post administration of the investigational drug.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] WP1066: There will be 5 groups based on the enrollment timing.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational JAK2/STAT3 inhibitor, caffeic acid analogue

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult (age 3 to 25) mixed malignant brain tumour trial (medulloblastoma, malignant glioma, DIPG/DMG, brain metastases); glioblastoma is not named, so not_glioblastoma (high-grade glioma unspecified would equally exclude). H3K27M DMG/DIPG patients are one of several eligible subgroups but H3K27M is not an entry requirement for the trial or an arm, so no biomarker row. Pharmacodynamic p-STAT3 in PBMC/serum pre/post dosing; optional tumour p-STAT3 from biopsy or surgery specimens if clinically indicated.
